data.text: Self-improvement coding executes only on GitHub-hosted runners using this repo and the existing Anthropic key securely stored as an Actions secret. The Mac runs the demo app and an exact-SHA-approved updater, never a coding worker. User explicitly permits scoped backend feature generation and checked automatic repo merges when the local operator selects that mode; review-only mode remains available. Ordinary voice conversation saves a draft only. This does not authorize automatic Mac installation, public hosting, supplier execution, spending-rule changes or firmware changes.
